name: Perspective
description: Corrects perspective by mapping four corner points (a quadrilateral to the full frame, or the frame to a quadrilateral).

params.name: top_left
params.description: Point for the top left corner, 0..1 of the frame (FFmpeg x0, y0)

params.name: top_right
params.description: Point for the top right corner, 0..1 of the frame (FFmpeg x1, y1)

params.name: bottom_left
params.description: Point for the bottom left corner, 0..1 of the frame (FFmpeg x2, y2)

params.name: bottom_right
params.description: Point for the bottom right corner, 0..1 of the frame (FFmpeg x3, y3)

params.name: sense
params.description: 0 = source (the points are locations in the source that go to the corners of the output), 1 = destination (the corners of the source go to the points in the output)
